Fixed-three negative control essentially flat. Earlier eight-seed full Playground affinity-auto6 CPU29.81% and whole elapsed18.16% lower.

families.actual_work: Actual first-quarantine event observer, device/pacing controls;14 paired timing jobs for host synchronization,39 recovery-vs-sync jobs; actual hardware cancellation/reap/fresh-field and scalar material/clear/guard oracle cases.
families.code: Required host synchronization retained; recovery prototype implemented, exercised on real GPU and rejected.
families.outcome: Startup GPU contexts cost roughly114–116MiB while useful completion low; recovery increased committed GPU fields but added CPU and wall cost across varied workloads.
families.decision: Keep synchronization correctness and permanent-failure safe CPU fallback; reject recovery as optimization.
